title: bupleurum ranunculoides f. syntomum
intro: Bupleurum ranunculoides f. syntomum, commonly known as Chinese Thorowax or Small Stem Bupleurum, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving liver function. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum ranunculoides f. syntomum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and exert hepatoprotective effects. Bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
